positioning: Complement Boeing/Spirit authoritative systems with a read-only, replayable cross-system evidence-assurance layer; do not pitch another generic manufacturing dashboard or replacement MES/QMS/PLM stack.

public_existing_controls.observed_capability: Boeing reports guided manufacturing data entry, built-in validation checks, easier engineering-information access, improved parts/completed-work tracking, expanded inspections, work-in-process tracking, RFID tool control, work-instruction adherence checks, safety/quality training, and six production-health KPIs.

FAA reported eight months of data demonstrating consistent production quality and continues inspections, audits, production-quality trend monitoring, approved-design compliance oversight, SMS and safety-culture oversight.

preferred_wedge.name: Cross-system requirement-to-evidence lineage
preferred_wedge.value: Reconcile engineering/customer/contract requirements against supplier planning, APQP evidence, inspection, NCR/RCCA and shipment records while retaining source and revision provenance.

preferred_wedge.name: Independent replay and assurance
preferred_wedge.value: Recreate why a record was allowed, blocked or escalated without silently changing the authoritative production system.

preferred_wedge.name: Supplier APQP evidence debt
preferred_wedge.value: Expose missing, stale, contradictory or weakly supported Process Flow/PFMEA/Control Plan/SPC/MSA/FAI and verification evidence before release.

preferred_wedge.name: Configuration and open-work closure graph
preferred_wedge.value: Tie engineering revision, BOM, supplier plan, build record, open work and shipment evidence into one auditable release path.

preferred_wedge.name: Quality-gate anti-bypass controls
preferred_wedge.value: Keep schedule/production pressure separate from evidence disposition and record any override request as a visible governed event.

initial_data_boundary: Sanitized, authorized, export-controlled-as-required representative data only; no production write authority.
initial_success_metrics: percentage of decisions with complete replayable lineage
robustness to missing, stale, contradictory and out-of-order inputs
claims_boundary: This positioning is a technical hypothesis derived from public signals and existing Worldshepherd capabilities. It is not Boeing/Spirit validation, adoption, or a measured productivity/safety improvement claim.
